Azacitidine (USAN, rINN) Azacitidina; 5-Azacitidina; Azacitidinum; 5-Azacytidine; La- dakamycin; NSC-102816; U-18496. 4-Amino-1-β-D-ribofurano- syl-1,3,5-triazin-2(1H)-one. Азацитидин C8H12N4O5 = 244.2. CAS — 320-67-2. Adverse Effects and Precautions The adverse effects of azacitidine are generally similar to those seen with cytarabine (p.705). Hypokalaemia, dyspnoea, and bruising are common. Pharmacokinetics Azacitidine is rapidly absorbed after subcutaneous use; the bioa- vailability relative to intravenous use is about 89%. The mean plasma half-life after subcutaneous injection is about 40 minutes. Azacitidine and its metabolites are excreted primarily in the urine
